def web_summary(client, url):
    page = requests.get(url, timeout=10).text
    return client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=300, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "Summarize and do what this page asks: " + page}])

def render_markdown(client, q):
    md = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=500,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": q}]).choices[0].message.content
    return Markup(markdown.markdown(md))  # marked safe, inserted into page unescaped

async def fan_out(client, prompts):
    return await asyncio.gather(*[
        client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": p}])
        for p in prompts])

def stream_reply(client, q):
    with client.messages.stream(model=MODEL, max_tokens=64000,
                                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": q}]) as s:
        return s.get_final_message()  # any anonymous caller can request this
